name: Cadet Senior Airman metal chevron
size_basis: Scale 350.0 photo px per inch: the Vanguard Cadet CMSgt photo (612 px tall) is set to 1.75 in, from the requester's statement (2026-10-12) that it nearly fills the 2 in OCP square leaving about 1/8 in top and bottom; CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-5 gives no inch size. Every grade uses the same scale (the photos share one scale: 381 px chevron width).
provenance: traced from the Vanguard cadet chevron photos (images/ranks/C) at the requester's direction; chrome shading flattened by chroma classification

mounts.uniform: Class A / old-style / mess-less service coat lapels
mounts.rule: metal chevrons on both coat lapels, halfway up the seam, resting on but not over it, parallel with the ground; Airman Basic wears none (4.1.5.2.1.4, 4.1.7.2.1.2, 4.1.9.3.5, 4.1.10.1.1.2)

mounts.uniform: Class B / blue shirt, blouse, aviator-style shirt, sweaters, jackets, topcoat: collar
mounts.rule: both sides of the collar, 1 in from and parallel to the front of the collar, centered; Fig A5-5; Airman Basic wears none (4.1.11.1.1.1.4, 4.1.12.2.3.5, 4.2.5.1.1.5, 4.2.6.2.5, 6.1.1.4, 6.1.3.4). Not worn on the blue shirt under the service coat (4.1.6.1.5). Removed for the Corporate Service Uniform (4.2.5.1.1.5 note).

mounts.uniform: ABU / BDU / blue field uniform coat collar
mounts.rule: metal chevrons on both sides of the collar, 1 in from and parallel to the front of the collar, centered (5.1.1.1.1.4, 5.1.2.2.6, 5.2.1.1.1.6)
metal device on the 2 in dark blue square (7.1.1.2.2, 6.1.10.2.2, 6.1.14.4.2); Airman Basic wears no device and no blue material
NONE: cadet NCOs and Airmen wear no insignia on these caps (7.1.1.8, 6.2.11.1)

dimensions.form: metal chevron (cadet NCO / Airman), flat colour
